method: Every non-reprint card from Lorwyn Eclipsed through Reality Fracture (and their Commander decks) was checked against the 20 most recently updated Bracket 2-3 Kadena decks on Moxfield and EDHREC's Kadena pages, then filtered for face-down creatures (morph, disguise, manifest, cloak). Game Changers excluded.
summary: Kadena draws a card for every face-down creature, but the new sets printed almost nothing face-down, so the new-set list is short: a creature tutor, a mana dork and a land. The EDHREC section is where most of the value is. The badge on each card counts the sources that include it; "Claude's pick" means no list runs it yet.

sets.name: EDHREC Recommendations
sets.note: Cards Kadena players commonly run in Bracket 2 and 3 that aren't in your deck, from EDHREC's bracket pages and average decks. Game Changers removed (Seedborn Muse, Cyclonic Rift, Fierce Guardianship, Worldly Tutor, Demonic Tutor, Rhystic Study). Sorted by how often they're played.

picks.cutWhy: does little in a deck that spends its mana on its own turn

picks.name: Formidable Speaker
picks.why: Three mana: discard a spare card to tutor any creature, so it finds your best morph, Kozilek or a finisher. Its untap ability also lets you reuse a mana rock or a tapped creature.
